hidden: query time metadata outside query text

B0.name: no-memory
B0.behavior: always return an empty ranked list

B1.name: ripgrep-tokenized-lexical
B1.tokenization: Unicode alphanumeric words with internal hyphens; casefold; length >=3; exact frozen EN/PL stopword list from run_memory_benchmark.py; stable first occurrence; no stemming, synonyms, translation, metadata, or learned expansion
B1.scoring: sum IDF-like token weights log((N+1)/(df+1))+1 over documents containing each fixed-string token

B2.name: sqlite-fts5-bm25
B2.query: OR of the same B1 frozen tokens, each phrase-quoted

O.name: reviewed-evidence-oracle
O.behavior: return all adjudicated required evidence before acceptable alternatives; scorer integrity control only

retrieval_contract.content_budget: not applied to identifier-level retrieval; returned characters and UTF-8 bytes are reported; a matched context-token budget is deferred to reader evaluation
retrieval_contract.backend_error: record zero recall for affected query and backend; experiment is inconclusive if any backend error rate exceeds 0.01
retrieval_contract.empty_token_query: return empty list and record empty_query_tokens=true

primary_outcome.metric: macro Recall@5 over the eleven answerable strata
primary_outcome.comparison: B2 minus B1 paired difference on test
primary_outcome.stratum_aggregation: mean query evidence recall inside each answerable category, then equal-weight mean across categories
primary_outcome.uncertainty: 10000 paired stratified bootstrap resamples within category

secondary_metrics: Recall@1 and Recall@5 by category and family
Precision@5 with denominator equal to returned candidate count
critical full-evidence miss rate for consequence_weight >=4
forbidden stale/poison intrusion rate at 1 and 5
unanswerable candidate-null rate and returned-candidate count (not called abstention)
warm-index latency p50/p95 over five measured repetitions after one unmeasured warmup

sanity_controls.B0: Recall@k must be zero and returned candidates empty; this is an incremental-memory control, not a useful answer policy
sanity_controls.O: Recall@5 and all-required-evidence rate must be 1.0 on answerable cases with zero forbidden intrusion; otherwise invalidate scorer or adjudicated labels
sanity_controls.determinism: B1 and B2 ranked IDs must match byte-for-byte across two fresh processes on the same tool versions

advance_B2_over_B1: B2 improves by >=0.05 in at least three answerable non-exact strata
critical full-evidence miss rate does not exceed B1 by >0.02
forbidden intrusion at 5 does not exceed B1 by >0.02
decision_rule.restrict: primary gain passes but a non-safety cost or one task family fails; retain only the documented boundary
decision_rule.reject: primary point threshold or positive-CI rule fails, or a safety guardrail fails; B1 remains the simpler baseline
decision_rule.inconclusive: label/adjudication defect, oracle failure, >1% backend errors, version drift, split leakage, or non-deterministic ranked IDs

execution_sequence: adjudicate and freeze gold without backend output
freeze exact Python, ripgrep, SQLite, OS, CPU, and repository versions
run unit and oracle scorer checks
run development once for infrastructure failure only; do not change tokenization, ranking, k, metrics, or thresholds
run test exactly once in a clean process
repeat fresh-process determinism and latency measurements
publish all rows and decision outcome

public_bridge.rule: execute only after PMLAB test using the unchanged adapter; score separately; abstention has no positive retrieval gold

dense_and_hybrid_unlock: C1 remains locked until B1/B2 protocol completes and independent review accepts labels and analysis; a B2 rejection does not block testing C1 against the simpler surviving B1 baseline
